plan.title: Manage Line Items Save With Empty Price

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Create an eRFX draft with an RFQ stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Create the single line item needed for the Manage Line Items window.
Complete the initial pricing sheet so the draft can be saved and reopened.
Save the event as the precondition for the Manage Line Items test.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in Drafts.
Open the draft created by this plan.
Open the Manage Line Items window.

args.goal: In the Manage Line Items window, select a product from the product dropdown, enter 90 in the Quantity field, leave the Price field blank, click Save, and stop when the screen shows that saving was refused.

steps.note: Perform and observe the exact drawer interaction because no domain step directly represents clearing the price and saving the line item.
Assert that saving with the blank price was refused.
